Package ep.service

Class CourseManager

java.lang.Object
ep.service.BaseManager
ep.service.CourseManager
public class CourseManager extends BaseManager
Use case 1, Manage Courses. Adds, edits and deletes courses and enforces the two rules: a name cannot be empty and cannot be repeated, and deleting a course only clears the link on events and assignments.
